Headline: "Droughts Spread Coast to Coast Across the U.S."

The graph depicts a map of the United States and the droughts across the country. The darker an area is, the more severe the drought is. One thing I noticed is that in Western Texas, in nearby towns such as Presidio and Van Hom, the area is a very dark red. This indicates that the drought there is very severe. Also, I noticed the most severe droughts are located in areas where there are lots of plains, like the Great Plains, such as Oklahoma, Montana, and Wyoming. One thing I wonder about is how we can deal with droughts and if there is any way to reduce the serious effects of them. This map relates to me and my community because I live in New Jersey, and the map shows the dryness in my state and the area I live in. While the dryness is more severe in South Jersey, it is still abnormally dry in North Jersey, making the whole state dry and miserable.
